import os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,time,selectors,json,signal
source = "import { test, expect } from 'bun:test';\ntest('fresh watch state', () => {\n expect(globalThis.__yfWatchLeak).toBeUndefined();\n expect(process.env.YF_HARNESS_WATCH).toBeUndefined();\n expect(fetch.name).not.toBe('leakedFetch');\n expect(console.log.name).not.toBe('leakedLog');\n globalThis.__yfWatchLeak = true;\n process.env.YF_HARNESS_WATCH = 'leaked';\n globalThis.fetch = function leakedFetch() {};\n console.log = function leakedLog() {};\n process.stderr.write('WATCH_FRESH_STATE_PASS\\n');\n});\n"
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='yf-watch-') as directory:
 path=pathlib.Path(directory)/'watch.test.ts'
 path.write_text(source)
 child=subprocess.Popen(['python3','tests/migration/offline.py','bun','--watch','test',str(path)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
 output=b'';changed=False;passed=False
 try:
  selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();selector.register(child.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+12
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if selector.select(.2):
    data=os.read(child.stdout.fileno(),65536)
    if not data:break
    output+=data
    if b'WATCH_FRESH_STATE_PASS' in output and not changed:
     time.sleep(.2);path.write_text(source+'\n// trigger restart\n');changed=True
    if output.count(b'WATCH_FRESH_STATE_PASS')>=2:
     passed=True;break
 finally:
  os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM);status=child.wait(timeout=5)
 print(json.dumps({'passed':passed,'observedPassingRuns':output.count(b'WATCH_FRESH_STATE_PASS'),'childReturnCode':status,'terminationSignal':'SIGTERM'}))
 if not passed:raise SystemExit(1)
